rules.name: Explicit Acceptance Required
rules.statement: A Delivery Assignment must not transition to an active state until the assigned Delivery Partner explicitly accepts the assignment.
rules.condition: When a delivery slot is allocated to a specific agent
exceptions: Emergency override by platform operations manager for critical time windows
rules.if_violated: The system blocks the start of the delivery task and prevents proof of delivery submission
rules.rationale: Ensures agents are committed to the task before resources are locked and customers are notified

parameters.name: acceptance_timeout_minutes
parameters.description: Maximum time allowed for an agent to accept or reject an assignment before auto-reassignment

rules.name: Cancellation Proof Rejection
rules.statement: The system must not validate a Proof of Delivery if the associated Delivery Assignment is in a cancelled state.
rules.condition: When a delivery agent attempts to submit proof of delivery
exceptions: Manual override by customer support for fraud investigation
rules.if_violated: The proof of delivery is rejected and the order remains in 'In Transit' status, triggering a re-assignment alert
rules.rationale: Prevents fraudulent closure of orders where the agent has abandoned the delivery

parameters.name: cancellation_grace_period_minutes
parameters.description: Time window after cancellation where proof submission is still technically allowed for logging

rules.name: Refund Block on Assignment
rules.statement: No new Delivery Assignment may be created for an Order Request while a refund transaction is actively processing.
rules.condition: When a refund is initiated for an order
exceptions: Exceptional cases approved by senior finance officer for inventory correction
rules.if_violated: The system prevents the creation of a new assignment and queues the order for manual review
rules.rationale: Prevents double-fulfillment and financial loss by ensuring no new logistics are triggered during financial disputes

parameters.name: refund_processing_duration_hours
parameters.description: Maximum duration a refund can block new assignments before review

rules.name: Feedback Assignment Binding
rules.statement: A Feedback Record must only be linked to a specific Delivery Assignment to attribute performance metrics to the correct partner.
rules.condition: When a customer submits a delivery rating or complaint
exceptions: System-generated automated feedback for technical failures unrelated to agent performance
rules.if_violated: The feedback is rejected or logged as 'Unattributed', preventing accurate agent performance tracking
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate attribution of quality issues to the specific agent responsible for the delivery leg

parameters.name: feedback_window_hours
parameters.description: Time limit after delivery completion to submit feedback

rules.name: Active Agreement Requirement
rules.statement: Order Requests must not be allocated to a Store Partner unless the associated Store Partner Agreement is in an 'Active' state.
rules.condition: During order allocation to a specific store partner
exceptions: Emergency manual override with senior management approval (proposed)
rules.if_violated: The order allocation is rejected and the customer receives a notification of unavailability
rules.rationale: Prevents operational chaos and financial disputes by ensuring only valid commercial relationships are utilized

parameters.name: active_state_threshold
parameters.description: Defines the specific status value required for allocation eligibility

rules.name: Minimum Order Value Enforcement
rules.statement: Order Requests may only be submitted if the sum of item prices is greater than or equal to the minimum order value defined in the active Store Partner Agreement.
rules.condition: At the point of cart validation before order submission
rules.if_violated: The order submission is blocked and the user is prompted to add items to meet the threshold
rules.rationale: Ensures economic viability of small orders and covers fixed operational costs for the partner

parameters.name: minimum_order_value
parameters.description: The mandatory minimum cart total for a specific partner agreement

rules.name: Dynamic Commission Rate Application
rules.statement: Financial Transaction Records must calculate revenue shares using the commission rate from the most recently active Store Partner Agreement valid at the time of transaction finalization.
rules.condition: During financial settlement and revenue calculation
rules.if_violated: Settlement records are flagged for manual review and potential financial reclamation
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate revenue distribution based on the current contractual terms, preventing over or under-payment

parameters.name: commission_rate
parameters.description: The percentage or fixed fee defined in the active agreement

rules.name: Escalation Hierarchy Adherence
rules.statement: Dispute resolution regarding Store Partner Agreements must strictly follow the escalation path defined within the agreement document.
rules.condition: When a contractual dispute or exception occurs between platform and partner
rules.if_violated: The dispute ticket is escalated to senior management for policy review and potential contract amendment
rules.rationale: Maintains contractual integrity and ensures consistent handling of conflicts according to agreed terms

parameters.name: escalation_path
parameters.description: The defined sequence of roles or departments for dispute resolution

rules.name: Perishable Expiry Enforcement
rules.statement: The system must prevent any Product Catalog item with an active expiry alert from being added to an Order Request.
rules.condition: when an Order Request is composed or updated
exceptions: items with a 'Sale' status explicitly allowing expired stock for clearance
rules.if_violated: The system rejects the Order Request and logs a compliance error for the user
rules.rationale: To ensure food safety and regulatory compliance by preventing the sale of expired perishables

parameters.name: expiry_threshold_hours
parameters.description: time window before expiry triggering an alert

rules.name: Discontinued Item Blocking
rules.statement: The system must not allow the inclusion of any Product Catalog item marked as permanently discontinued in a new Order Request.
rules.condition: when a customer or agent attempts to add an item to an order
exceptions: manual override by a senior administrator for inventory write-off purposes
rules.if_violated: The system blocks the item selection and displays a 'Product Unavailable' message
rules.rationale: To prevent revenue leakage and customer disputes regarding non-existent inventory

parameters.name: discontinuation_status
parameters.description: flag indicating permanent removal from sale

rules.name: Tax Reproducibility Mandate
rules.statement: The system must calculate tax liabilities deterministically using the exact same Order Request, Product Catalog snapshot, and Delivery Zone Map data.
rules.condition: during financial settlement and audit review
rules.if_violated: The transaction is flagged for manual reconciliation and potential regulatory penalty
rules.rationale: To ensure financial integrity and enable reproducible tax audits across jurisdictions

parameters.name: calculation_snapshot_id
parameters.description: unique identifier for the data state used in calculation

rules.name: High-Velocity Alert Scope
rules.statement: The system may only generate predictive inventory replenishment alerts for items explicitly classified as high-velocity in the Product Catalog.
rules.if_violated: Alert fatigue occurs, causing critical stockouts for key items to be missed
rules.rationale: To focus limited operational attention on items with the highest turnover and risk of stockout

rules.name: Geographic Boundary Integrity
rules.statement: The system must not assign an order to a Delivery Zone unless the customer's address falls strictly within the defined polygon or radius boundaries of a Store Partner's service area.
rules.condition: When validating a customer's delivery address against the Delivery Zone Map
exceptions: Emergency override for medical situations with explicit manager approval
rules.if_violated: The order is rejected immediately and the customer is notified that the location is outside the service area
rules.rationale: Prevents impossible deliveries and protects the platform from liability regarding unfulfillable promises

parameters.name: boundary_tolerance_meters
parameters.description: Maximum allowable deviation for address geocoding errors

rules.name: SLA Consistency Enforcement
rules.statement: The system must only publish a delivery time estimate if the calculated travel time based on real-time traffic and road constraints remains within the Store Partner's agreed Service Level Agreement (SLA).
rules.condition: When generating a delivery time estimate for an order request
exceptions: Premium expedited service tiers with higher SLA limits
rules.if_violated: The system must not confirm the order and must prompt the customer to select a later time slot or a different store
rules.rationale: Ensures that all promised delivery times are operationally achievable to maintain trust and avoid late deliveries

parameters.name: max_allowed_travel_time_minutes
parameters.description: Maximum travel duration permitted under the current SLA

rules.name: Dynamic Fee Recalculation Trigger
rules.statement: The system must automatically recalculate the delivery fee whenever the real-time traffic data indicates a change in travel time that exceeds the baseline estimate by more than the configured threshold.
rules.condition: When real-time traffic data updates during the order preparation phase
exceptions: Manual fee waivers authorized by customer support for verified emergencies
rules.if_violated: The customer receives an updated total cost notification and must accept the new fee or cancel the order
rules.rationale: Ensures pricing accuracy reflects current network congestion and road conditions

parameters.name: traffic_variance_threshold_percent
parameters.description: Percentage increase in travel time required to trigger a fee recalculation

rules.name: Regulatory Zone Activation Gate
rules.statement: A Delivery Zone Map must not be activated for commercial use until the defined service boundaries have been legally validated and approved by the relevant regulatory authorities.
rules.condition: When a new Store Partner or Service Area Definition is created or modified
exceptions: Internal testing environments or sandbox zones excluded from public commerce
rules.if_violated: The system blocks the activation of the zone and prevents any orders from being placed in that area
rules.rationale: Ensures strict adherence to local laws and regulations governing service areas and data usage

parameters.name: regulatory_approval_status
parameters.description: Current status of legal validation for the specific zone
